threats.point: Promoter selling is a warning about insider conviction.

A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
The company experienced negative cash flows due to its business model of keeping ready stock.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The reason for being negative cash flow is like, we utilize all the funds and we keep the stock readily. We don't deal on order-to-order basis. So our jewellery stocks are always ready." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

threats.point: The company previously exited Gold Metal Loans due to high volatility in gold prices.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "So earlier also we used to do GML and all, but due to the high volatility, we went on -- we came out from GML." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)
